crossRefs.note: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.
His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.

translations.web: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.
translations.bsb: Then Jesus’ mother and brothers came and stood outside. They sent someone in to summon Him,
translations.kjv: There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.
translations.asv: And there come his mother and his brethren; and, standing without, they sent unto him, calling him.
